item.title: Shakur Stevenson takes WBO junior welterweight belt from Teofimo Lopez at Garden
item.description: Stevenson impresses by earning a unanimous decision and has now won a world title in four separate weight classes.

item.title: Anthony Edwards, Julius Randle lead Timberwolves to a 131-114 victory over the Grizzlies
item.description: Anthony Edwards scored 33 points, Julius Randle added 27 points and seven assists, and the Minnesota Timberwolves won their fourth straight, 131-114 over the Memphis Grizzlies.

item.title: New Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski adds more Browns flavor to staff by naming Alex Van Pelt QBs coach
item.description: New Atlanta coach Kevin Stefanski has added more Cleveland Browns flavor to his Falcons staff by hiring Alex Van Pelt as quarterbacks coach.

item.title: Understated triumph: Elena Rybakina wins the Australian Open with calm precision
item.description: Elena Rybakina is bringing her understated style back to the biggest stages in tennis.

item.title: Ayo Dosunmu's season-high 29 points lead short-handed Bulls past Heat, 125-118
item.description: Ayo Dosunmu scored a season-high 29 points as the short-handed Chicago Bulls topped the Miami Heat 125-118.

item.title: Amen Thompson's near triple-double lifts Rockets over Mavericks in thrilling finish
item.description: Amen Thompson had 21 points, nine assists and eight rebounds to lead the Houston Rockets to a 111-107 victory over the Dallas Mavericks on Saturday night.

item.title: Shooting at Louisiana parade leaves 5 people wounded, including 6-year-old , sheriff says
item.description: A Louisiana sheriff says five people including a 6-year-old were wounded when gunfire erupted during a small-town parade Saturday.

item.title: Cavs acquire Ellis and Schroder in 3-team trade with Kings and Bulls, AP source says
item.description: The Cleveland Cavaliers acquired guards Keon Ellis and Dennis Schroder from Sacramento in a three-team deal that sends forward De'Andre Hunter to the Kings.

item.title: ESPN closes deal for NFL Network, rights for RedZone which gives the NFL a stake in the network
item.description: ESPN has finalized its purchase of NFL Network and other league digital assets after receiving approval from government regulators.

item.title: Costa Ricans vote on outgoing president's conservative populist program
item.description: Costa Rican voters are set to decide between continuing the policies of outgoing conservative populist Rodrigo Chaves by electing his selected successor — or giving a new chance to traditional parties seeking to shed a reputation as being self-serving.
